comment: The tier list states the parity gate checks (web/tests/e2e/parity-tiers.spec.ts) at 1440 x 1000. ws_tiers.py ranks each mock from data/builds/<active build>/bis (band 60, preset raid), the files the fixture build publishes on /tiers; tests/e2e/support/tiers-parity.ts opens the build signed out, or signed in as the mock's sample character (Thandrel, Fury Warrior 60). web-tiers-bar (phone, controls open) and web-tiers-states (the states sheet) are not page states at 1440.
